Where it began

Will Jacks was born in Chertsey on 21 November 1998. He went to the 2018 Under-19 World Cup with England, playing all six of their matches and captaining the side in the last.

That same year his senior career began in a rush. He made his List A debut for Surrey in May 2018, hit a match-winning 121 against Gloucestershire in only his third game, and played his first Championship match in June. By the end of the summer he was a county champion, part of the Surrey side that won the 2018 title.

The player

He is a right-handed batter and an off-spinner. His Test debut came on 1 December 2022 against Pakistan, on the tour where he also played his first T20 international. By November 2026 he had played 6 Tests, scoring 234 runs with a best of 47 and taking 12 wickets, with one five-wicket haul of 6 for 161. He was part of England's party for the 2025–26 Ashes in Australia and played in the series.

White-ball cricket is where his name is up in lights. At the 2026 T20 World Cup he won four player of the match awards, a feat only Shane Watson had managed before him in the tournament's history.

What made him special

Speed of scoring. In a pre-season T10 game against Lancashire he reached a hundred in 25 balls, with six sixes in one over on the way. In 2021 he hit a 15-ball fifty against Middlesex, and in 2022 his 108 from 48 balls set a new high for an innings in the Hundred. Playing for Royal Challengers Bangalore in 2024 he led a chase against Gujarat Titans with an unbeaten 41-ball hundred that included ten sixes.

Test cricket asks for a slower kind of patience, and his numbers there are more modest. Five-day bowlers might take some comfort from that; the white-ball ones have had no such luck.

Away from the middle

He was a Championship winner again with Surrey in 2022, and he won the Hundred with Oval Invincibles in 2023. His travels have taken him into several of the world's Twenty20 leagues, and he was in England's squad for the 2024 T20 World Cup as well as the 2026 one.

And finally

Any cricketer who has hit six sixes in an over has a story to tell at dinner parties. Will Jacks has a few more than that, most of them over in about the time it takes to tell them.
